topic: How Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) Store Facts in Transformers

outline.topic: How Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) Store Facts in Transformers

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Transformer Architecture Anatomy
sections.content: Briefly introduce the Transformer block, distinguishing between the Attention mechanism (contextual relationships) and the MLP blocks (knowledge storage/processing). Visualize the MLP as the 'long-term memory' unit.
sections.example: Imagine the Attention mechanism is the 'reading desk' where words look at each other, while the MLP is the 'bookshelf' where facts are stored.

sections.title: The MLP as a Key-Value Associative Memory
sections.content: Explain that an MLP layer consists of two linear transformations with a non-linear activation (ReLU/GeLU). Graphically represent this as a 'Pattern Matcher' (Key) followed by a 'Fact Output' (Value).
sections.example: When the input 'The capital of France is' hits the MLP, the first layer detects the pattern (Key), and the second layer retrieves the specific vector representation for 'Paris' (Value).

sections.title: Mathematical Visualization: The Weights as a Database
sections.content: Use a graphical representation of matrices. Show how weights (W1 and W2) act as memory slots. When input 'x' enters, the matrix multiplication identifies a 'neuron cluster' that activates specifically for that fact.
sections.example: Visualizing a 3D matrix cube: Input vector 'x' intersects with specific weight planes, illuminating a path that leads to the activation of the 'Paris' node.

sections.title: Case Study: Fact Editing and Activation
sections.content: Discuss how specific neurons or sub-layers hold specific factual knowledge. Explain that training adjusts these weights so the model 'memorizes' the association.
sections.example: If the model says 'The capital of France is Lyon', we adjust the weights in the MLP layer to 'suppress' the Lyon-neuron and 'excite' the Paris-neuron.

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
sections.content: Wrap up by synthesizing: Attention manages context, while MLPs function as a high-dimensional, distributed lookup table. Reiterate that facts are not stored in one place, but encoded across weight patterns.
sections.example: Like a digital jigsaw puzzle: no single piece is the image, but the alignment of all pieces (weights) creates the picture of the fact.

storyboard.title: Prerequisite: The Transformer Architecture Anatomy
lecture_lines: Transformers consist of Attention and MLP blocks.
Attention manages context, like a reading desk.
MLP blocks serve as long-term memory.
animations: Show Transformer block diagram with highlights on MLP layers using #3498DB color.
Zoom into MLP sub-layer showing hidden layers. Label layers #E74C3C.
Display weight matrices W1 and W2 in #2ECC71.
Animate signal flow through the MLP structure. Highlight in #F1C40F.
Summarize architecture, grouping components clearly with labels in #FFFFFF.

storyboard.title: The MLP as a Key-Value Associative Memory
lecture_lines: MLP layers are key-value associative memories.
First layer acts as a pattern matcher.
Second layer retrieves specific fact outputs.
animations: Display input vector with query. Highlight with #3498DB.
Show matrix multiplication as key look-up. Label #E74C3C.
Display output vector as retrieved value. Highlight with #2ECC71.

storyboard.title: Mathematical Visualization: The Weights as a Database
lecture_lines: Weights act as a high-dimensional database.
This illumination retrieves stored factual information.
animations: Visualize weight matrices as rows/columns. Label with #3498DB.
Show projection mapping input space to storage. Color #E74C3C.
Demonstrate retrieval with vector-matrix dot product. Use #2ECC71.

storyboard.title: Case Study: Fact Editing and Activation
lecture_lines: Specific neurons encode individual factual knowledge.
Training adjusts weights to update associations.
We can suppress or excite specific facts.
animations: Overlay specific fact-related activation heatmaps. Highlight #3498DB.
Show weight modification effect on retrieval. Label #E74C3C.
Animate final output change showing fact update. Use #2ECC71.

storyboard.title: Synthesis and Summary
lecture_lines: Attention handles context; MLPs store facts.
Facts are distributed across weight patterns.
Together, they form an intelligent system.
animations: Review MLP as key-value memory concept. Color #3498DB.
Flash key mechanisms: matrix look-up and projection. #E74C3C.
Show final takeaway on knowledge storage. Highlight #2ECC71.
